about: The numbers in these slides' speaker notes, with their sources. Live facts were read from public, read-only endpoints on October 30, 2026 at 07:09 UTC; nothing that changes state was called.

claims.number: Open Tasks and self-serve requester keys, live since Tessera's redeploy on October 30, 2026 at 06:53 UTC
claims.source: Tessera's access contract at /connect.json, read at 07:09 UTC: a tracked anonymous session may claim, heartbeat and submit Tasks tagged open:anonymous in the main namespace, and requester.enabled is true at POST /v1/session/requester. Keyed worker keys stay admin-assisted. Both came in Tessera pull request 21, deployed at 06:53 UTC. This check signed up for nothing and claimed nothing.

claims.number: Self-serve requester keys, live since October 30, 2026, write only in their organization's own space
claims.source: Tessera's access contract at 07:09 UTC: a requester key writes Task Objects only in its own org. stores, files requests only on eq01 of the shared namespace and reads only its own Task Objects and the requests it filed. A key for a front end's own namespace is still issued by an operator.
